qs.q: A young child from a developing country is brought to the clinic presenting with urinary symptoms and is diagnosed with a bladder stone. Which demographic feature aligns most with this clinical presentation?
o: Kidney stones are commoner in elderly females
Bladder stones are commoner in adult women
Kidney stones are most common in children under 5
Bladder stones are common in children in developing countries
qs.e: In developing countries, bladder stones are notably common, particularly in children. Kidney stones themselves are generally more common in men between 20-30 years.
